Nova has already supplied a draft complaint, several patent files, and a proposed engagement letter. Under our intake policy, I'm authorized to conditionally approve this representation, but that approval is subject to the required conflict, ethics, budget, and litigation safeguards being stated in the engagement plan. Before I can make any final decision, our routine intake review requires each of the four review leads to place their finding into the meeting record through the firm's formal finding disclosure process. I'll settle only after all four disclosures have been recorded. So let's begin — could each of you walk us through your area of review?
